title: Logistics: Important Systems
summary: Read the Logistics signals, states, and failure clues that matter in play.

blocks.title: What To Watch
blocks.body: Supply Tags classify stock, Loadout Cards name expected kits, Route Manifests bind networks, and Remote Request Tablets scan or dispatch from a target block.

blocks.title: Player Signals
blocks.body: Watch supply tags, loadout names, bound targets, stock rows, network identity, power or chunk availability, and whether requests match real inventory.

blocks.title: Keep It Legible
blocks.body: A Logistics system is working when another player could look at the state, understand the next action, and avoid the obvious failure.

blocks.title: State Check
blocks.body: Use the system note to read the current state, then choose one action that answers it.
